effects.text: Transform your tool set into a different one.

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Cast Time: 1 minute (1 scrap): You transform your tool set into a different one.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): The first check you make with these new tools has a +5 bonus.

Passive: You always have the last tool set you created.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Omni-Tool (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Omni-Tool" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Swap the tool set yourself.
